What a performance today lads, 4 goals, clean sheet and controlled the game incredibly well. Congratulations! 

Enjoy your weekends, parents thank you for all your support! See you all next week at training 👏

Huge game against Howick tomorrow, let’s give them a big fight and come away with the win 💪

Because it suits most people, we will do a 2:30pm-3:45 training tomorrow.

See you all then.

13a.message: I’m coming up to Selwyn now to watch the end of Ethan’s game, if you wanted to chat about it at all.

13a.message: Hiya. Just to let you know Keita, that Liam Howie‘s dad came to complain to me after the game today. He has a general concern that it’s unfair for the kids to not have equal minutes. I explained that in the first team, the coach absolutely has discretion to play whatever team he chooses, and that the school has offered more game time as a guarantee in other teams if that’s what wanted. So as not to create a conflict on the sidelines, I’ve encouraged him to discuss his concerns with you directly. I’ve made it really clear that it is not your fault, and that you have inherited the issue and you are managing across multiple teams with similar situations. He didn’t seem to care. Just a heads up that he is coming your way. I would say that he was quite emotional, and clearly frustrated.
13a.author: Nick Mackeson-Smith

13a.message:
Great away win today boys... 4-0 against Sacred Heart in Round 4 🔴⚫
Asaf got us going inside four minutes and added a second before the break, Liam M made it two on 16', and Pedro grabbed the fourth in the second half. 3-0 at half time, 4-0 at full time.
Around 13 shots, a header off the post, roughly 85% of the ball and a clean sheet at the other end. Total control from whistle to whistle. Well done everyone 👏

13a.message:
We will need to do a rotation of who sits out each week, so 4 can sit out this Saturday, then they will be back in the team for the next game and a different 4 will sit out. Because there are 20ish(?) players, this will mean each player will sit out around once every 5 weeks depending on who’s available. 

For example maybe you want your best player to be sitting out on the same day as a weaker player so that it evens it out when players are in and out. You don’t want to end up having all your weaker players in and stronger ones out. 

For now I can ask those players that you listed to fill in for the 14b team and we can sort a rotation next week so players know when they are sitting out.
13a.author: Keita Elliott

13a.message: So it has to be stronger and weaker players or just weaker players, because I think it’s unfair for them to come if they are gonna be on the bench. Rather the weaker players getting game time for other team but can come to trainings.
13a.author: Mojtaba Sayed

13a.message:
Hey guys, for the 4 players standing down each week we will have to do an even rotation, I can do this for you but I don’t know the ability of the boys. I assume you’d want some weaker players with some of the stronger ones standing down to balance it out? Unfortunately we can’t ask players to move down to the 13b teams as this was a selected team. 

Can you give me the names of 4 boys you’d like to stand down this week - they can either play for the 14b or 13b team. 

We can figure out a full rotation next week maybe so that after Kings Birthday weekend the players will know when they are sitting out. 

I hope this makes sense? Let me know if it doesn’t!

13a.message:
Good win today boys — 5–1 against Westlake 🔴⚫
They got us early (2') but Finn levelled it up with an OG assist and then scored his own a minute later. 2–1 at the break.
Second half was all ours — Asaf with two (29', 41') and Blake getting in on it too (34', assist Harry). 5–1 at full time.
Jake with 3 saves in goal. 7 shots on target, 64% of the ball. Well done to everyone 👏
